title: Fumble
tagline: Batch dump your trashbags. Gas optimized. Emotionally reckless.
description:
Fumble is a gasless, swipe-to-dump wallet cleaner for degens haunted by their bags.
👈 Left swipe = dump it. 
👉 Right = keep. 

Each swipe signs an order. One final click sends them all to token hell. 🔥

Built on 1inch Fusion for gas optimization. Powered by shame, regret, and CT cope.
You clean your wallet. We meme your pain.
how_its_made: Built on top of 1inch Fusion, Fumble is a gasless, dopamine-soaked dApp that lets you swipe through every token in your EVM wallet like it’s Bumble for bags. Once you’ve judged them all—dump or cope—we handle the carnage. Behind the scenes, we deploy a smart account counterfactually using MetaMask Delegation Toolkit and Pimlico for gas sponsorship, with session keys enabling silent signing. We encrypted and stored those keys in localStorage using per-chain salts—a small but effective hack to preserve UX without compromising safety. All transactions route through a single entry point and are sponsored via ERC-4337 user ops, allowing us to abstract away every technical step from the user. The result? A single swipe per chain, one final prompt, and we handle the rest—gasless, seamless, and instant.
